'''Robert Jones''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Huntsville tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with no-obj. ties, according to John Camp's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2658">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-huntsville-the-deep-7-14-1d2658/ huntsville-the-deep-7-14-1], DeckTech (John "1ManScanCrew" Camp, 18 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-huntsville-the-deep-7-14-1d2658/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
